question: According to 2011 Census, what is the population density of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**382 persons per square kilometre.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Population density is the number of people living per unit area of land, usually expressed as persons per square kilometre or square mile.**
 
• The population density of India is **382 persons per square kilometre.**
